post.description: Scan editable same-tenant properties for evidence similarity. Never merges records.

get.description: Evidence comparison for one candidate. Similarity is not title proof.

post.description: Append a human review. Never merges properties or verifies claims.

patch.description:
Correct one property's label and jurisdiction.

The actor is the creator, or a current delegated writer, and holds an owner or editor role.
Another property record is not merged or deleted.

get.description: Delivered ledger rows for one visible property. The response has no claim text or document bytes.
Metadata only. Ciphertext stays in the database and is not selected.

post.description: Quarantine one synthetic file. Nothing in the request can mark it clean.

put.description:
Link a quarantined document to an unverified claim, live source, and/or current identifier.

Non-null fields in the body replace the matching link; omitted (null) fields keep the
current attribution. Attribution does not change claim verification, source rights,
identifier status, or scan_state. Export packets include these refs and still set
title_verified false.

get.description: Release bytes only after a clean scan. Quarantined and failed files are refused.

post.description: Ask the configured scanner. An absent scanner leaves the file quarantined.
Append a human note or keep-unresolved mark. Does not verify claims or clear conflicts.

get.description: Surface unresolved evidence signals without adjudicating title or claim truth.
Read-only projection of existing attribution edges. Never asserts title or verification.

post.description: Build the caller's packet only after the database records a live creator consent.
Record one identifier. The same value is unchanged. A different value needs supersede or conflict.
Store a review. Optional source/claim/document/identifier citations stay non-title.
Register a source. The caller cannot choose rights_status; the database keeps it unknown.
